dedupe_keys.name: latency aware routing and spectrum assignment with deep reinforcement learning

description: Carlos Hernandez and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. The study evaluates a previously trained deep-reinforcement-learning agent that selects routes and spectrum for elastic-optical lightpaths. Experiments vary traffic load and compare with a traditional algorithm, reporting a growing advantage as resources become scarce. Coverage is the provisioning experiment; exact latency objectives, topology and trained weights are not exposed in the short abstract. An exact registered companion describes two reference-network simulations and integration of the trained agent into the CTTC ADRENALINE SDN testbed; these are retained as method validation, not a new independent model. No operational service-level guarantee follows from these reported tests. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements.
